cards.back:
The part of your body above your neck.
Bahasa Indonesia: kepala
Example: I wear a hat on my head.
cards.say: head. I wear a hat on my head.

cards.back:
The thin strands that grow on your head.
Bahasa Indonesia: rambut
Example: She has long black hair.
cards.say: hair. She has long black hair.

cards.back:
You use it to see.
Bahasa Indonesia: mata
Example: I close my eye to sleep.
cards.say: eye. I close my eye to sleep.

cards.back:
You use it to hear.
Bahasa Indonesia: telinga
Example: I have two small ears.
cards.say: ear. I have two small ears.

cards.back:
You use it to smell.
Bahasa Indonesia: hidung
Example: I smell the cake with my nose.
cards.say: nose. I smell the cake with my nose.

cards.back:
You use it to eat and talk.
Bahasa Indonesia: mulut
Example: Open your mouth, please.
cards.say: mouth. Open your mouth, please.

cards.back:
A hard white part in your mouth.
Bahasa Indonesia: gigi
Example: I brush every tooth.
cards.say: tooth. I brush every tooth.

cards.back:
The front of your head.
Bahasa Indonesia: wajah
Example: Wash your face with water.
cards.say: face. Wash your face with water.

cards.back:
The part between your head and body.
Bahasa Indonesia: leher
Example: A giraffe has a long neck.
cards.say: neck. A giraffe has a long neck.

cards.back:
The part of your body from shoulder to hand.
Bahasa Indonesia: lengan
Example: I lift my arm up.
cards.say: arm. I lift my arm up.

cards.back:
The part at the end of your arm.
Bahasa Indonesia: tangan
Example: Wave your hand to me.
cards.say: hand. Wave your hand to me.

cards.back:
One of five parts on your hand.
Bahasa Indonesia: jari
Example: I have ten fingers.
cards.say: finger. I have ten fingers.

cards.back:
You use it to walk and run.
Bahasa Indonesia: kaki (tungkai)
Example: My leg is very strong.
cards.say: leg. My leg is very strong.

cards.back:
The part at the end of your leg.
Bahasa Indonesia: telapak kaki
Example: I put a shoe on my foot.
cards.say: foot. I put a shoe on my foot.

cards.back:
One of five parts on your foot.
Bahasa Indonesia: jari kaki
Example: I have ten toes.
cards.say: toe. I have ten toes.

cards.back:
The part in the middle of your leg.
Bahasa Indonesia: lutut
Example: I hurt my knee.
cards.say: knee. I hurt my knee.

cards.back:
The part where your arm joins your body.
Bahasa Indonesia: bahu
Example: Put the bag on your shoulder.
cards.say: shoulder. Put the bag on your shoulder.

cards.back:
The part inside your body where food goes.
Bahasa Indonesia: perut
Example: My stomach is full.
cards.say: stomach. My stomach is full.

cards.back:
The part of your body behind you.
Bahasa Indonesia: punggung
Example: My back is straight.
cards.say: back. My back is straight.

cards.back:
The part in the middle of your arm.
Bahasa Indonesia: siku
Example: I bend my elbow.
cards.say: elbow. I bend my elbow.

cards.back:
The part in your mouth that tastes food.
Bahasa Indonesia: lidah
Example: Show me your tongue.
cards.say: tongue. Show me your tongue.

cards.back:
To look happy with your mouth.
Bahasa Indonesia: tersenyum
Example: Please smile for the photo.
cards.say: smile. Please smile for the photo.
